summary.text: Steve Wilson serves Ohio's 7th Senate District, which covers Warren County and a portion of Hamilton County. He was appointed in 2017 to fill a vacancy and chairs the Financial Institutions, Insurance and Technology Committee.

paragraphs.text: Wilson earned a B.A. in finance from Miami University in 1972, served as a Navy Lieutenant, and began his banking career at Lebanon Citizens National Bank (LCNB), eventually becoming CEO.
He served as a board member for the Federal Reserve Bank of Cleveland and as Lebanon City School District's School Board President.
His legislative accomplishments include establishing financial literacy and capitalism requirements for high school students and modernizing Ohio's notary laws to allow secure virtual notarization.
He and his wife, Jill, live in Maineville.
